summary: The winning portrait goes forward with {liaison}'s objection attached to the recommendation.
realLife: During debate on the highest-scoring design for physician Susan La Flesche Picotte, the liaison questioned the likeness and members unanimously requested a correction.
gates: A liaison has reviewed the likeness on a scored portrait design.
inGame: needs: liaison objection and portrait recommendation.

turns.what: The liaison accepts a revised likeness.
turns.pulledBy: The artist works from an authenticated photograph.

turns.what: The family disputes the new likeness too.
turns.pulledBy: A second reference image differs from the first.
turns.writesBack: The portrait returns for another review.
